      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Call sites may easily forget to unwrap the inner result and miss interruption",
      "quote": "Seems fragile to use `util::Result<InterruptResult>`. Wrapping one result into another is fragile, because call-sites may easily forget to unwrap the inner result",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author replied that replacing with Result<void, InterruptResult> would be fine and safer, though not yet changed",

      "status_by_id": "rc:1707623223",
      "status_by_quote": "It sounds like you want `Result<InterruptResult, void>` to be replaced with `Result<void, InterruptResult>` which would "

      "id": "c:4171045172",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Result-style error handling undermines runtime performance and runs contrary to C++ idioms",
      "quote": "I see Result-style error handling as a rustism that should be kept out of the C++ codebase of Bitcoin core.",

      "status": "open",

      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Ignoring the return value from FlushStateToDisk while allowing it to mutate validation state creates inconsistencies",
      "quote": "the return value from `FlushStateToDisk` is ignored, but it can cause change in `state` -- unclear if this was intended or just an unintended side effect.",
